column3: The Phantoms of Flordon Station House
column5: Following the closure of Flordon Railway Station, the occupant of the station house experienced distressing phantom cries and a gentle ghostly touch while alone at night.

column3: The Phantom of the Rampant Horse
column5: Passersby and residents have reported seeing a mysterious dark figure peering from the upper windows of the former Rampant Horse public house in Gayton. Occupants have also experienced unexplained cold spots and missing items within the historic building.

Tolhouse Gaol in Great Yarmouth is plagued by the tormented spirits of those imprisoned and executed during Matthew Hopkins' 1645 witch trials. Visitors and staff frequently report physical encounters with unseen hands, extreme temperature drops, and bloodcurdling screams echoing through the historic building.

column3: The Phantom Hound of the Hempton Railway Crossing
column5: A spectral dog reportedly haunts a former railway crossing at midnight on the anniversary of its death after being struck by a steam train.

column3: The Treasure of the Lily Pond Well
column5: A hidden treasure chest was recovered from an old well near Hoe Hall, and its iron handle was subsequently attached to the village church door. site lost-treasure
